items.name: How Weird Street Faire
items.detail: The official site (howweird.org) reads "2000 — 2024 ... The Faire is done." Many third-party calendars still list it as an active annual SF event.

items.name: Ghirardelli Chocolate Festival
items.reason: No current edition published by the venue
items.detail: Ghirardelli Square's official events page does not list a Chocolate Festival for 2026 or 2027; the most recent documented edition is the 23rd in September 2018. Excluded from the tables rather than carried as an active annual event.

items.name: Great Dickens Christmas Fair
items.reason: Not inside the City and County of San Francisco
items.detail: Frequently listed in "San Francisco" round-ups, but the fair is held at the Cow Palace in Daly City (San Mateo County). Excluded by the SF-only geography rule.

items.name: Super Bowl LX / FIFA World Cup 2026 matches / 49ers games
items.reason: Not inside the City and County of San Francisco
items.detail: Played at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara. Widely marketed as San Francisco events and therefore a common false positive in SF event lists.
